row.body: A door key is kept with a cleaning bottle and a checklist that says the rooms were clear. The back asks for one more walk-through before reopening.
row.title: Clear on the first pass

sidecar.gloss: A completed clearance is followed by a request for another inspection.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program site might require a routine recheck after cleaning; the list does not say why it was closed.

row.body: the leather strips and bath towel are wedged beneath unused warning tape. footprints pass around the bundle rather than toward it.
row.title: missing count beside the leather strips

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
